statements.status_notes: The rtph264depay and rtph265depay RTP depayloaders do not bound the fragment reassembly buffer, so a peer that never sends an end-of-fragment marker can exhaust process memory. gst-plugins-good1.0 is part of the WebKit media dependency set that upstream Playwright's install-deps mandates for Debian 13. Upstream fixed this in GStreamer 1.28.6 and Debian carries the fix only in unstable (1.28.6-1); trixie ships 1.26.2-1+deb13u2, so no fixed package is available for Debian 13 yet. Whether Playwright-driven WebKit sessions can route untrusted RTP streams to these depayloaders is under investigation.
